50:36.text: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And
, they ran for a refuge in the land! Could they find any place of refuge
(for them to save themselves from destruction)

50:37.text: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.

50:38.text: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.

50:39.text: all that they say, and glorify the Praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before

50:40.text: And during a part of the night
[As-Sunnah, Nawâfil - optional and additional prayers. And also glorify, praise and magnify Allâh - Subhân Allâh, Alhamdu lillâh, Allâhu-Akbar]

50:41.text: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.

50:42.text: The Day when they will hear As-Saihah
in truth: that will be the Day of coming out
(from the graves, i.e. the Day of Resurrection)

50:43.text: Verily, We it is Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.

50:44.text: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them,
hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.

50:45.text: We know best what they say. And you
are not the one to force them
. But warn by the Qur’an; him who fears My Threat.

51:2.text: that bear heavy weight of water.

51:3.text: that float with ease and gentleness.

51:5.text: Verily, that which you are promised
(i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds)

51:6.text: And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.
